phrases.en: I have a reservation under Kaya.
phrases.usage: İsim için "under" kullanılır. Resepsiyonda ilk cümlen bu olur.
phrases.example: Hi, I have a reservation under Kaya. — Let me find that for you.

phrases.en: I'd like to check in, please.
phrases.usage: Ayrılırken "check out". İkisi de ayrılabilir fiildir.
phrases.example: Good afternoon, I'd like to check in, please.

phrases.en: Do you have any rooms available?
phrases.usage: Rezervasyonsuz gittiğinde. "vacancy" kelimesi de tabelalarda görülür.
phrases.example: Do you have any rooms available for tonight?

phrases.en: What time is check-out?
phrases.usage: Burada "check-out" isim olduğu için tire alır. Cevap genelde 11 ya da 12'dir.
phrases.example: What time is check-out? — Eleven, but we can hold your bags.

phrases.en: Is breakfast included?
phrases.usage: Aynı kalıp: "Is Wi-Fi included?", "Are taxes included?"
phrases.example: Is breakfast included? — Yes, seven to ten in the lobby.

phrases.en: Could I get a late check-out?
phrases.usage: Genelde ücretsiz verilir, sormaya değer. Erken giriş için "early check-in".
phrases.example: My flight's at eight — could I get a late check-out?

phrases.en: What's the Wi-Fi password?
phrases.usage: Günümüzün en çok sorulan otel sorusu. "code" da denir.
phrases.example: What's the Wi-Fi password? — It's on the back of your key card.

phrases.en: Could we get an extra towel?
phrases.usage: "extra" her istek için işler: extra pillow, extra blanket, extra key.
phrases.example: Could we get an extra towel and a blanket?

phrases.en: The air conditioning isn't working.
phrases.usage: Arıza bildirmenin standart kalıbı: "The X isn't working."
phrases.example: The air conditioning isn't working — could someone take a look?

phrases.en: There's no hot water.
phrases.usage: "There's no..." eksiklik bildirmenin en kısa yolu.
phrases.example: There's no hot water in room 304.

phrases.en: The room next door is really loud.
phrases.usage: Şikâyeti kişiselleştirmeden bildirir. Devamı: "Could you say something?"
phrases.example: Sorry to call so late — the room next door is really loud.

phrases.en: Could I change rooms?
phrases.usage: Sebebini eklemek şansını artırır: "...it's too noisy."
phrases.example: Could I change rooms? This one faces the street.

phrases.en: Could you hold my bags until three?
phrases.usage: Check-out sonrası şehirde gezmek için. Neredeyse her otel kabul eder.
phrases.example: I've checked out — could you hold my bags until three?

phrases.en: Is there a safe in the room?
phrases.usage: "safe" isim olarak kasa demektir; sıfat hâliyle karıştırma.
phrases.example: Is there a safe in the room? — Yes, in the closet.

phrases.en: Do you have a room with a view?
phrases.usage: Ayrıntı için: "a sea view", "a city view".
phrases.example: Do you have a room with a view? — A sea view is thirty more.

phrases.en: Could you call me a taxi?
phrases.usage: "call me a taxi" = taksi çağır demektir; "bana taksi de" gibi bir şaka anlamı da vardır ama kimse yanlış anlamaz.
phrases.example: Could you call me a taxi for seven a.m.?

phrases.en: Is there anything to see nearby?
phrases.tr: Yakında gezilecek bir yer var mı?
phrases.usage: Resepsiyondan tavsiye almanın en kolay yolu.
phrases.example: Is there anything to see nearby? — The old town is a ten-minute walk.

phrases.en: Could I have a wake-up call at six?
phrases.usage: "wake-up call" isim olarak tire alır. Mecazi anlamı da "uyandırıcı bir ders"tir.
phrases.example: Could I have a wake-up call at six, please?

phrases.en: I'd like to extend my stay by one night.
phrases.usage: "extend by" ne kadar uzatacağını söyler; "extend to" hangi tarihe kadar olduğunu.
phrases.example: I'd like to extend my stay by one night, if possible.

phrases.en: I think there's a mistake on the bill.
phrases.usage: "I think" ile başlamak suçlayıcı olmadan itiraz etmeni sağlar.
phrases.example: I think there's a mistake on the bill — I didn't use the minibar.

phrases.en: Could you put it on my room?
phrases.usage: Otel restoranında ödeme yerine odaya yazdırmak için.
phrases.example: Could you put it on my room? Number 512.

phrases.en: My key card isn't working.
phrases.usage: Sık yaşanır; resepsiyon saniyeler içinde yeniler.
phrases.example: My key card isn't working — could you reactivate it?

phrases.en: Do you have laundry service?
phrases.usage: Uzun konaklamalarda işe yarar. Ücret genelde parça başınadır.
phrases.example: Do you have laundry service? — Yes, drop it off before nine.

phrases.en: We had a great stay, thank you.
phrases.tr: Çok güzel bir konaklama oldu, teşekkürler.
phrases.usage: Çıkışta söylenen kibar kapanış. Personel bunu duymayı sever.
phrases.example: We had a great stay, thank you — we'll be back.

phrases.en: Is there a shuttle to the airport?
phrases.usage: "shuttle" iki nokta arasında gidip gelen servis aracıdır.
phrases.example: Is there a shuttle to the airport? — Every half hour, it's free.
